references.text: A very similar event in Gibeah, where the men of the city surround the house and demand to 'know' the guest—a direct parallel to the men of Sodom.
The men of Sodom were wicked and sinned greatly against the Lord—the background for the event in Genesis 19.
Paul refers to homosexual acts as an example of humanity's fall away from God.
Jude warns against immorality by referring to Sodom and Gomorrah, which pursued strange flesh and were punished with eternal fire.
Revelation compares the moral decay in the great city with Sodom.
Isaiah describes how the people of Sodom openly display their sin without hiding it—relevant to the open wickedness in Sodom.
